rulings.three_markers_vs_binary: KEEP three. [主张] (self-report) and [推断] (inference) have DIFFERENT verification paths - the former re-checks toward a person/other-agent, the latter toward direct measurement - so collapsing to a binary 事实/非事实 loses the 'which re-check channel' distinction and breaks the upgrade path. [已验证] is the upgraded lifecycle state, inherently separate. Three is the minimal meaningful set; not overkill.
rulings.in_place_upgrade_vs_new_entry: KEEP in-place rewrite.
